title: Triage pulse + quick followups
content:
2026-03-13 morning pulse - quick scratchpad

Context:
- Spike overnight: several customers reported missing widgets and stale metric tiles on Console > Team Overview (region: us-west1). Some reports from staging too.
- Not a full outage, more 'data not updating' / UI showing 0s. Likely upstream metrics pipeline or cache TTL regression.

What I saw (09:05-10:30):
- Team Overview: all latency widgets show 0 for last 15m, raw metrics in Prometheus are fine for the same time window.
- Embeddings-usage tile shows correct numbers in API usage page -> suggests dashboard query vs cache mismatch.
- Staging repro: toggling time range (1h -> 24h -> 1h) sometimes forces update.

Quick repro steps I used:
1) Open console -> Team Overview (us-west1 account) -> observe 0 p50 latency
2) Open network tab -> dashboard api call /api/dash/query?id=team-overview&type=timeseries -> response payload contains "last_value": 0 but prom query shows >0
3) Hit /admin/metrics-cache/flush?team=1234 -> subsequent dashboard request returns fresh values

Hypothesis:
- Cache service recently got a TTL change in the last deploy (see PR 489) and some keys are being short-circuited to 0 on miss. Alternatively serialization bug that maps missing datapoints to 0.
- Could be a race where aggregator writes metric shards slightly delayed and cache returns empty array which UI converts to 0.

Quick checks to run next:
- Check cache service logs for 2026-03-12 22:00 - 02:00 UTC window for 5xx / cache-miss patterns (service: metrics-cache).
- grep for "serialize" or "null->0" in PR 489 changes.
- Confirm whether any quantization / aggregation job ran overnight (runbook: infra/metric-aggregator).

SQL / Prom queries I ran:
- Prom: max_over_time(request_latency_p50[15m]) by (team)
- SQL (housekeeping): SELECT max(ts) FROM metric_ingest WHERE team_id=1234 AND metric='request_latency_p50';

Immediate mitigations (temp):
- Manual cache flush endpoint seemed to restore values for affected teams. Not ideal to run for many teams.
- Rolling back PR 489 on a small canary (staging) to validate if behavior reverts.

Tickets / owners I want to create/assign:
- JIRA:RINF-1723 (create): Investigation - Team Overview tiles showing 0s. Assign to Ryan P (obs lead) - due EOD.
- JIRA:RINF-1727 (create): Hotfix - prevent cache miss -> 0 mapping. Assign to Luca M.

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Speak with frontend (Ella?) about how UI treats empty datapoints. Is there a recent change converting null->0? Slack: @ella.nguyen in #console-ux.
- Add instrumentation: return cache-miss header X-Metric-Cache: miss/hit so we can correlate frontend->cache. Quick PR idea: add header in /api/dash/query response.
- If root cause is aggregator timing, consider making UI tolerant: show "no data" instead of 0 and surface last update time.

Open questions:
- Was there a change to cache key format in PR 489? If so, stale keys might never be found and code uses fallback zero.
- Any rate-limited cache errors? 429s? That might manifest as zeros too.

Todo (ordered):
- [ ] Create RINF-1723 with logs/samples (include network payloads) - due today - Maya
- [ ] Push small instrumentation to dashboard API to include X-Metric-Cache - quick PR - Maya -> draft branch triage/metric-header
- [ ] Ask Ryan for access to metrics-cache logs + pointer to retention - Ryan
- [ ] Ask frontend about null->0 mapping - message Ella in #console-ux - Maya
- [ ] If reproduces, schedule brief war room (15m) and invite infra + frontend - target window: afternoon

Random notes / scratch (do not forget):
- copy sample response (saved as snippet) -> /tmp/triage_teamoverview_20260313.json
- check deploy history: console-service and metrics-cache deployed 2026-03-12 21:47 UTC (deploy tags: console@v1.38.2, metrics-cache@v3.4.1)

End of morning pass. Will update after Ryan confirms logs or after I push header PR.

-- Maya (notes, quick, noisy)
